Proposed acceptance: (1) stage exists; dev pushed once q-store-remote is answered; (2) Docker Playwright summary + vitest run copied; (3) specs/design-system/ui-inventory.json valid, totals equal 00-program section 2, propsUsed rollup present; (4) golden baseline on v3 for 16 exports + 30 icons recorded; (5) after Tailwind v4: golden equal within tolerance and toHaveScreenshot green on every matrix page, counts copied; preset compatibility finding in docs/design-system/tailwind-v4-migration.md with command outputs; (6) specs/design-system/token-map.json with 26 rows and usageCount; (7) product-grid rendered from @ivanprotsko-org/renderer + block-gen on live products, screenshot + seams list; engine-side needs written to artifacts/deliverables/app-shell-requests/.

T0a+T0b 5c4c6d2 (orchestrator A, worktree feat/ds-foundation from dev@ed335b8): stage branch created from dev, dev NOT pushed (q-store-remote open, origin is the public gorgojs fork). Toolchain verified on this machine before any agent prompt (25i): corepack pnpm 10.11.1 is mandatory (bare pnpm on PATH is 8.12.0, refuses lockfile v9); Playwright 1.63.0 + image v1.63.0-noble -> "corepack pnpm ui-lab:test" printed "2 passed (5.1s)"; container reaches host.docker.internal:9022/health 200 and :8000/en 200; vitest 4.1.11 -> "No test files found" exit 0 (pinned to 4.1.11 not 5.0.0 because 5.0.0 needs @types/node ^22 and the workspace is on ^20.19.0); npx tsc --noEmit exit 0, next lint clean; GitHub Packages readable, renderer 1.0.3 / block-gen 1.2.1 (note: "set -a; . ~/upready/.env.keys" yields an EMPTY token, the working form is grep -m1 + cut). Confirmed known risk: @medusajs/ui 4.2.1 peer react ^18.3.1 vs installed react 19.0.5, reproduced by this install. package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml are orchestrator-only for this task so parallel agents cannot collide on them. Step 0 remainder is running as workflow wf_1ff5aaa5-c9b: registry (Sonnet) + Next smoke (Opus) in parallel, then ui-lab harness/v3 baseline (Opus) + token map (Sonnet), then Tailwind v4 (Opus), then an adversarial verifier (Opus); agent reports land as JSON in artifacts/docs/step0/ and only thin envelopes come back (25h). Open: q-ds-inventory-rollup-schema (totals.additionalProperties is false, so the propsUsed rollup needs a schema bump; written to a sidecar file meanwhile).

ARCHITECT ANSWER to q-ds-inventory-rollup-schema (2026-09-06, closed): bump upready.ui-inventory/v0 IN PLACE, no v1 — the registry does not exist yet, so there is no consumer to break. totals.propsUsedByComponent is now a REQUIRED property of totals: key = the SAME "<package>:<Component>" string as totals.byComponent (so the two objects join on one key), value = prop name -> number of call sites writing that prop, spreads counted under "<spread>". Schema-valid therefore MEANS rollup-present, one gate instead of two. The sidecar specs/design-system/ui-inventory-props-rollup.json is CANCELLED: the rollup lives inside specs/design-system/ui-inventory.json, do not commit the sidecar. Per-entry props stay as they are ($defs.entry.props already holds the literal props of each call site).
